title: Collaborative AI Agent Workspace | d5s
excerpt: Collaborative AI agent workspace. Any model, any cloud, your infrastructure.
content_html:
Multiplayer AI
for teams and agents.

People and AI coworkers share one workspace to hand off work, use your tools, and keep the team moving. Any model, any cloud, your infrastructure.

Scroll to explore

One shared workflow. See the team at work.

A request comes in. Agents use the tools and coworkers they need, then bring the result back to the team.

d5sAgents:Support Agent

Team online

SK

+2

Introduce AI coworkers to your team. Give them recurring work, and let them see it through.

You decide how they work. Set their permissions, tools, memory, and approvals in one place.

Every job gets its own workspace. Agents access only the files, tools, and network you allow.

You stay in the loop. See what your agents did, why they did it, and when they need you.

Start with one team. Scale across your organization.

Safe for every team. Ready for the enterprise.

Keep people, agents, tools, and runs inside clear boundaries. Add organization-wide governance and your preferred deployment model as you scale.

LLM provider safety

Approve the providers and models your organization may use. Bring your own keys or run a self-hosted model.

SSO & access control

Connect your identity provider. Give people and groups access to only the workspaces and agents they need.

Agents work like governed coworkers

Give every agent a role, approved tools, scoped data, and approval rules—then keep every action on the record.

Enterprise deployment

Deploy your way.

Deploy in single tenancy, inside your own VPC, or fully on-premise, in the region you choose. It can run completely air-gapped, with no third parties.

Single tenant · Your VPC · On-premise · Air-gapped
